name: Member's Mark Chicken Enchiladas with Salsa Verde (Take & Bake)
whyItWorks: Soft corn tortillas stuffed with shredded rotisserie chicken and mild green tomatillo salsa verde, topped with melted Monterey Jack. Tomatillo acidity and cheese make it a remission food.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake until heated through. Scrape off excess melted cheese if lactose sensitive, and enjoy with plain white rice.
